# God-Tier macOS Development Environment

> A reproducible, user-space macOS development environment using Mise as the central orchestrator. Strict hierarchy: Mise > Bun > Pixi > Uv. Zero system modifications - everything installs to ~/.local.

This project provides a complete development environment setup for macOS with AI-first tooling, modern CLI utilities, and reproducible configuration via Pkl/TOML.

## Quick Start

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ray-manaloto/gemini-ai-macos-development-environment/main/README.md): Setup guide with architecture overview
- [CLAUDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ray-manaloto/gemini-ai-macos-development-environment/main/CLAUDE.md): AI assistant context and development patterns
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ray-manaloto/gemini-ai-macos-development-environment/main/AGENTS.md): Project knowledge base for AI agents

## Configuration

- [mise.toml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ray-manaloto/gemini-ai-macos-development-environment/main/config/mise.toml): Mise tool configuration (tools, tasks, settings)
- [starship.toml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ray-manaloto/gemini-ai-macos-development-environment/main/config/starship.toml): Shell prompt configuration
- [pixi.toml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ray-manaloto/gemini-ai-macos-development-environment/main/pixi.toml): Conda-forge dependencies

## Specifications

- [Tool Management Spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ray-manaloto/gemini-ai-macos-development-environment/main/openspec/specs/tool-management/spec.md): Requirements for Mise, Bun, Pixi, Uv with Gherkin scenarios
